writes.note: Thermostat setpoint raised to 60.0 C. The probe cruises near 27 C, so the heater can never reach setpoint and never switches off -- a survival heater stuck on, which is a real and common spacecraft fault.
Bus budget trimmed to 2050 mW. Nominal load is 1855; the stuck heater adds 300, so the power manager begins shedding the two lowest-priority loads -- the camera, then the radiation counter.
